text:
alex: Trying to bring up new GPU cluster in ap-southeast-2. Need a short checklist for syncing Terraform state and Pulumi stacks so we don't stomp each other. Any gotchas for quotas or networking?

maya: +1 on a checklist. Biggest pain we hit last time was missing remote state locking and duplicate stack names. Also AWS quota for p4/g4 is low in some regions. File a quota increase early.

jordan: FYI we have a ci job that creates the base infra: `ci/infra/bootstrap-region` and a separate `ci/infra/pulumi-sync` that does the higher-level app stacks. Make sure `tf-backend` exists before any tf plan runs.

samir: Quick checklist idea (short):
- ensure `tfstate-<region>` s3 bucket + dynamodb lock exists
- pulumi backend: `pulumi login s3://pulumi-state-<region>` or use `pulumi service` depending on customer
- confirm KMS key and grant to CI principals
- check GPU quota requests opened with cloud provider
- validate VPC CIDR + peering/routing with existing regions
- run `terraform init -backend-config` locally to verify

alex: Can you paste the `backend` snippet we expect in CI so I can add to the PR?

samir: Sure — here's the minimal terraform backend we use in ci (replace <region> and bucket):
```
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "redwood-tfstate-ap-southeast-2"
    key    = "clusters/ap-southeast-2/infra.tfstate"
    region = "ap-southeast-2"
    dynamodb_table = "redwood-tf-locks"
  }
}
```

maya: For Pulumi we usually do:
```
# login on CI runner
pulumi login s3://pulumi-state-ap-southeast-2
# pulumi stack init prod-ap-southeast-2 or stack select
```
Also add `PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE` / KMS unwrap if needed.

jordan: Ops note: CI job order should be: `bootstrap-region` (tf core infra) -> wait for endpoints reachable -> `pulumi-sync` (higher stacks) -> `health-check` (prom probe). Make the `bootstrap-region` job idempotent.

ops-bot: Reminder: open quota requests take ~48-72 hours in AP regions.

alex: Are there specific networking validation commands we should include in the handoff? I want to hand to oncall after provisioning.

samir: Minimal validations to run post-provision:
- `kubectl get nodes` (node count matches expected GPUs)
- run a tiny GPU pod: `kubectl run gpu-test --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:11.0-base --requests= 'nvidia.com/gpu:1' -- sleep 300`
- check metrics: `sum(kube_node_status_capacity_gpu_total)` in Prometheus should reflect new capacity
- vpc connectivity: attempt curl to internal endpoints in other regions over peering

maya: Also attach this to the PR: `infra-ci-bot` will create branch `region/ap-southeast-2/bootstrap` and run: `terraform plan -out=tfplan` then `terraform apply tfplan` on merge. Add reviewer `@jordan` and `@samir`.

alex: What about state migration if someone accidentally starts with local state? Any rollback steps?

jordan: If local state shows up, do NOT `terraform apply`. Run `terraform state pull` to compare. If local resources were created, we `terraform import` them into remote state or delete local resources and re-run after remote init. Keep a screenshot and tag `#incidents` if you need a rollback.

infra-ci-bot: CI status: `ci/infra/bootstrap-region` queued. Logs will be at https://ci.redwood.internal/job/1759 (token required).

maya: Cost note: new GPU nodes -> add `cost-center` and `env` tags so billing shows. Also enable `autoscale` min nodes 0/1 depending on workload to reduce idle cost.

samir: One more thing: Pulumi stack names should be unique and include region: `prod-ap-southeast-2` not `prod-asia`. Avoid ambiguous names.

alex: Thanks — I'm creating the PR with the backend snippet and checklist. I'll ping when CI runs.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: branch `region/ap-southeast-2/bootstrap` created by alex.

alex: @maya @jordan assigning handoff: once `pulumi-sync` completes, handoff steps are in the checklist (post to #oncall and share the Prometheus dashboard link).

jordan: A couple quick links to paste in the PR:
- quota request form: https://cloudprovider.internal/quotas
- prom dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cluster-capacity/gpu-overview

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/821. Thanks all.

maya: :thumbsup: Good luck — ping if anything fails and we'll run the rollback playbook.
